specs.Compatible Devices: Cellular Phones, Earbuds, Headphones, Tablets, Mobile Phone, Smartphone, Smart Phone, Phones, Tab/Slate and Other Android Phone

features: ✅ 33W USB-C PD PPS CHARGING – This single-port Type-C wall adapter provides up to 33W output for compatible devices. PD and PPS support allow a compatible phone to request power within the adapter’s supported range. Actual charging speed depends on the device, cable and battery conditions.

✅ COMPATIBLE WITH NOTHING PHONES – Suitable for compatible Nothing Phone (4b), (4a), (4a) Pro, (3), (3a) Lite, (3a) Pro, (2a), (2a) Plus and (2) models. Pair the adapter with a suitable USB-C cable. Each phone charges according to its own supported specification, which may be lower than 33W.

✅ SUPPORTS CMF PHONE MODELS – Use with compatible CMF Phone 2 Pro and CMF Phone 1 devices. The compact adapter is convenient to keep beside your bed, on your desk or in a bag when you need an additional charging point for your phone.

✅ USEFUL FOR OTHER USB-C DEVICES – Can also charge compatible Pixel 9a phones, earbuds and other accessories that accept USB-C PD input. Check the charging requirements of each device; the adapter’s 33W rating is its maximum output, not a promise that every device will charge at 33W.

✅ ADAPTER-ONLY PACKAGE – The package contains one 33W USB-C wall charger adapter. A charging cable is not included. Use a cable suitable for your device and check the product label for its supported PD and PPS output ratings.
